comparison_method: stratified cross-validation within the calibration partition; thresholds calibrated independently per fold
threshold_optimization_metric: maximum recall under the configured strict calibration FPR cap
score_normalization: empirical within-domain normal-score ranks, with global-reference fallback
knn_score_normalization: mean-distance odds adjustment using standardized log-mel features; optional balanced autoencoder latent block

feature_blocks: locally saved autoencoder latent mean and standard deviation
